hogwarts.schedule: 50% at signing or when the trial ends, then 4 x 12.5% across the school year (D-20261117); the 11-08 schedule (12.5% at months 3, 6, 9, 12) is superseded
hogwarts.sudan: USD price paid in SDG at the bank rate on the payment day, by Bankak
hogwarts.quoting_currency: SAR (KSA pays by bank transfer, no VAT line; Sudan pays the SAR price in SDG at the bank rate via Bankak)
hogwarts.note: USD figure assumes 3.75 SAR/USD; rates.ts is the code source.

pricing.source: hogwarts src/components/saas-marketing/pricing/rates.ts; D-20261108-pricing-one-month-trial as amended by D-20261117-pricing-proportional-sar

first_payment.basis: D-20261117: Al-Ibda pays 50% from signing. USD/SAR shown at 48 students (offer) and 81 (production 2026-11-21); count unconfirmed. Contingent on signature - the 2026-12-19 date was the 11-08 rule and is superseded.

break_even.caveat: Cost basis is the unverified burn in runway.json; D-20261117 premortem quotes full cost ~$2,700-4,000/mo (needs ~5,000-7,500 students). Both are 'break-even' on different cost bases.

north_star_gate.note: 10 schools x 81 students = 810 students, below the 940 break-even; the gate and the break-even figure do not describe the same state.

_reconciliation_2026-11-24: Pricing basis: docs/NORTH-STAR.md and north_star.json (Q3 note, 12-month row) still assume flat $99-149/mo tiers; revenue/customers/pipeline use per-student 24 SAR. Notes added, targets not rewritten.
First payment date: 12-19 (11-08 decision, customers/revenue) vs on-signing (11-17 decision). Set to the 11-17 rule.
Al-Ibda size: 48 students in the offer, pipeline, customers (307.2 USD/yr) vs 81 in production (518.4 USD/yr).
Pilot count: revenue.json 1 pilot; customers.json 4 roster entries; pipeline.json pilot_recruitment 'current_signed 1 of 10'; plan says 5 CRM deals.
Break-even: 940 students (revenue) vs 4-5 schools (NORTH-STAR.md) vs 5,000-7,500 students (D-20261117) vs 10 schools gate.
